name: DeleteRecord
label: Delete Record
description: Deletes a record in SAP OData.

fields.name: ConnectionUrl
fields.label: Connection URL
fields.description: The base URL of the SAP OData service endpoint.

fields.name: EntitySetName
fields.label: Entity Set Name
fields.description: The name of the OData entity set (e.g., 'SalesOrder').

fields.name: KeyValue
fields.label: Key Value
fields.description: The key value of the record to delete (e.g., '0000000001').

fields.name: BearerToken
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication (if required).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The response from the OData server after deletion.
